free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: witness_hint does not specify head count; one query head keeps the CPU run small while the target decision only reads the module cache

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: witness_hint does not specify KV head count; one KV head divides one query head (multi-head attention layout)

free_parameters.name: gamma
free_parameters.why: witness_hint does not specify the attention coverage ratio; any value in (0,1) reaches the target and 0.9 is the repository example default

free_parameters.name: tau
free_parameters.why: witness_hint does not specify the query-aware head threshold; 0.0 is the function default

free_parameters.name: max_budget
free_parameters.why: witness_hint does not specify max_budget; 512 tokens maps to the same 4 blocks as the sequence, so the target decision is unaffected

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: the pinned CPU torch has no GPU-safe bfloat16 path; float32 is supported by every torch op on the path to the target

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed random seed for deterministic q/k/v tensors across repeats

mocks.reason: GPU triton kernel launcher called inside get_active_blocks after the causal_mask decision; a plain-torch average pool keeps the post-target path running on CPU
GPU triton block-sparse attention launcher called after get_active_blocks; delegates to the repository's own torch_block_wise_attention reference on CPU
